module: Feeds the on-screen task list (tasklist) during career delivery. It groups the loaded cargos by destination, the cargos to pick up by pickup location, the trailer/vehicle tasks, and an "active deliveries" header. Each element is marked to update or to discard, then sent to the UI every frame via guihooks (SetTasklistTask, SetTasklistHeader, DiscardTasklistItem).
notes: Element types: parcels, pickup, header, and the vehicle offer type (trailer or vehicle).
The 'parcels' groups are grouped by destination label; without a modifier the key is 'noMods', otherwise it includes groupId and the loading time.
For timed parcels, the subtext shows the time left before delayed, then before "very late", then "late".
offerIdToTasklistElementId is never emptied (only cargoIdToTasklistElementId is reset on each sendCargoToTasklist).
On discard, only the parcels, pickup, header, trailer and vehicle elements send a removal message to the UI.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook called on career activation: stores the delivery extensions.

sendCargoToTasklist.desc: Rebuilds the tasklist elements from the cargo containers of nearby vehicles (asynchronous): marks all the old elements to discard, recreates the parcels and pickup groups, the vehicle tasks (dVehicleTasks.getVehicleTasks) and the header with the number of tasks or loaded items.

updateTasklistForCargoId.desc: Marks to refresh the tasklist element that contains this cargo (useful for the countdown of timed parcels).

updateTasklistForOfferId.desc: Marks to refresh the element linked to a vehicle/trailer offer.

clearTasklistForOfferId.desc: Marks to discard the element linked to a vehicle/trailer offer.

clearAll.desc: Marks all elements to discard; they are removed at the next update.

updateCargoTasklistElements.desc: Walks through the elements: sends the removals (DiscardTasklistItem / SetTasklistHeader nil) and updates (SetTasklistTask with label, subtext, active, type='message') to the UI, then deletes the discarded elements. The labels depend on the current step of the vehicle tasks (coupleTrailer, enterVehicle, bringToDestination/confirmDropOff, putIntoParkingSpot).
